en.title: Solve It Step by Step! 🧩
en.description: Use AI hints to solve a math problem through reasoning, not just getting the answer.
en.outcome: You can use AI to get HINTS for solving problems instead of just copying answers!
en.explanation:
Here's a secret: getting the answer isn't the goal — understanding HOW to solve it is! 🎯

AI can be like a helpful tutor who gives you hints instead of answers. Let's practice with a fun word problem about planning a school event.

worked_example.scenario: Planning a school science fair budget.
worked_example.good_attempt:
Goal: Help me solve this word problem step by step with HINTS, not the answer.
Context: I'm planning a school science fair. I need to buy supplies.
Constraints: Give me one hint at a time. Wait for me to try before giving the next hint. Start by helping me identify what information I need.
Output: First hint only.
worked_example.why_better: Asks for hints instead of answers, so the student actually learns the method.

interactive_task.instruction:
Solve this problem using AI for HINTS (not answers!):

🧩 Problem: Your school is organizing a science fair. You need:
• 3 display boards at ₹150 each
• 2 packs of markers at ₹85 each
• 5 sheets of chart paper at ₹25 each
• 1 pack of stickers at ₹60

Your teacher gave you ₹800. Do you have enough money? If not, how much more do you need?

Instead of asking AI for the answer, write an AI instruction that gives you HINTS to solve it yourself!
interactive_task.starter_text:
My AI instruction for hints:

My work:
Step 1: 
Step 2: 
Step 3: 
Answer:
hints: First hint: List all the items and their costs. Can you find the cost of each type of item?
Second hint: For items with multiple quantities, multiply: quantity × price. Try the display boards first: 3 × ₹150 = ?
Third hint: Add up all the costs. Then compare with ₹800.
Final hint: If total > ₹800, subtract ₹800 from total to find how much more you need.
interactive_task.sample_good_response:
My AI instruction: I'm solving a word problem about a school science fair budget. Don't tell me the answer! Give me hints one at a time. Start by asking me what information I can find in the problem.

My work:
Step 1: List items - 3 boards (₹150), 2 markers (₹85), 5 chart paper (₹25), 1 stickers (₹60)
Step 2: Calculate each - Boards: 3×150=₹450, Markers: 2×85=₹170, Paper: 5×25=₹125, Stickers: ₹60
Step 3: Total = 450+170+125+60 = ₹805
Answer: Total is ₹805, budget is ₹800. I need ₹5 more!
evaluation_criteria: Asks for hints instead of direct answers

understanding_checks.question: Why is it better to ask AI for hints instead of answers?
options: You learn the method and can solve similar problems on your own
understanding_checks.explanation: When you work through problems with hints, you learn the method. Next time you face a similar problem, you can solve it yourself!

understanding_checks.question: What should you do after solving a problem with AI hints?
options: Check your answer by trying a different method or re-reading the problem
Ask AI to confirm your answer
understanding_checks.explanation: Double-checking builds confidence and catches mistakes. Try re-reading the problem or using a different calculation method.

feedback_templates.pass: 🎉 Fantastic work! You solved it step by step!
feedback_templates.partial: Good effort! 💪 Show more of your work for each step.
feedback_templates.fail: Let's try again! 🔄 Start by listing all the items and their prices.

en.retry_hint: Review the worked example and try again.
en.recap: You learned to use AI as a hints-tutor instead of an answer-machine! This way, you actually learn the method and can solve similar problems on your own. 🧠✨

glossary_terms.definition: A math question written as a real-life story or scenario.
Solving a problem one small piece at a time, showing your work.
